CO1: Take a URL apart and build one with urllib.parse, open pages with webbrowser, and read a robots.txt before fetching
CO2: Download a page or a file with requests, check the status code, raise an error for a failed request and save the body in binary chunks, and tell which of these were read and not run here
CO3: Find elements in HTML by a CSS selector with Beautiful Soup, read their text and attributes, and explain why a regular expression is the wrong tool for HTML
CO4: Decode the JSON answer of a web API, recognise its error answers, and convert its values
CO5: Analyze which tool a page needs - a downloader with a parser, or a browser driver such as Selenium or Playwright - and which claims of the chapter differ in current libraries and sites
_note: These chapter objectives serve the course outcome LO-7, collecting information from the web by fetching and parsing pages and by automating a browser; the approved outcome names chapter 13 of the 3rd edition as its own source.
